text: J.Bervas Automobiles, the Stade Brestois 29 lower-back sponsor, is the car-dealer name of the Brest holding SOFIPEL (SIREN 440978062, SAS, angle Bd de l'Europe / 175 rue de Gouesnou, Brest — the J.Bervas address), chaired by Marc Yvon Philippe Trébaol-Pelleau; Jacques Bervas (SIREN 900250978) is the founder-name company of the same Breton dealer network. No state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: J.Bervas Automobiles is run through the Brest holding SOFIPEL, chaired by Marc Trébaol-Pelleau.

source.name: Annuaire des entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), SIREN 440978062
source.note: Same response: nature juridique 5710 (SAS), siège angle Bd de l'Europe / 175 rue de Gouesnou, 29200 Brest.
